description:
Derive the new issue's advisory findings inside the creation mutation, from the image it captured, and return them with the created issue.

## Background

- `publish_issue_creation` (`crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:2417-2502`) captures a mutation base holding the image and every issue, discards the issues (`:2432`), evaluates local rules through `derive_write_validation` (`:1048-1084`) and returns its warnings. `create_issue` (`crates/jit/src/commands/issue.rs:167-225`) returns the created issue with those warnings.
- Graph-rule findings for a new issue are computed only by the CLI's human path after the commit, through `evaluate_graph_rules` over a fresh issue list and a whole validation capture (the `IssueCommands::Create` arm of `crates/jit/src/main.rs`).
- The transition path already evaluates graph rules purely from captured evidence with the mutation timestamp (`derive_state_transition`, `commands/mod.rs:1085-1215`). The mutation base captures plan documents, so `plan_content_with_issues` (`commands/validate.rs:1008`) supplies plan content. Issue-linked documents are not part of a mutation image, so document-reading passes are not evaluated here.
- Readers of the returned warnings: the `issue create` arm in `main.rs` and `tests/fast_rules/local_rule_enforcement_tests.rs:143`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Creation returns `findings`, in the wire `ReportedFinding` shape: the new issue's local-rule findings and the graph-rule findings attributed to it, evaluated over the captured issues plus the new record with the mutation's timestamp and plan content from the mutation image. It replaces the returned warnings.
- [hard] REQ-02: A harness test over `InMemoryStorage` shows that creating an orphan leaf returns its `orphan-leaf` finding and creating a compliant issue returns none.
- [hard] REQ-03: The listed readers read `findings`, and `issue create` prints today's warning lines from them.

## Notes

- Behaviour is unchanged in this change; output changes land with the CLI rendering.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Issue creation derives its findings inside its mutation
